title: Calendar Whiplash
blurb: History's timeline, but somebody shuffled it. Three are real. One is cap.

cards.say: [Betty White was born before sliced bread was first sold], [the first lighter was invented before the friction match], [Queen Victoria was still reigning when the Wright brothers flew], and [eyeglasses were invented before the printing press].
cards.real: Queen Victoria died in January 1901, almost three years before the Wright brothers' first flight in December 1903.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Gutenberg's press dates to about 1440; spectacles from 13th-century Italy confirmed here) https://www.college-optometrists.org/the-british-optical-association-museum/the-history-of-spectacles

cards.say: [Charles Dickens lived long enough to see the telephone patented], [Alexander Hamilton's widow lived long enough to see the California Gold Rush], [Charlie Chaplin lived long enough to see the Beatles break up], and [Ben Franklin lived long enough to see George Washington become president].
cards.real: Dickens died in 1870, six years before Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone in 1876.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (Bell's March 1876 patent confirmed; Dickens's 1870 death is textbook) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_Graham_Bell
NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: the Gold Rush began in 1848; Eliza Hamilton's 1757-1854 life confirmed here) https://www.nps.gov/hagr/learn/education/elizabeth-hamilton-schuyler-timeline.htm
NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: the Beatles split in 1970; Chaplin died on December 25, 1977) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Chaplin
NOT WEB-CHECKED (Washington's April 30, 1789 inauguration confirmed; Franklin's April 1790 death is textbook) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Washington

cards.say: [Muhammad Ali and Stephen Hawking were born in the same month], [Galileo was born the same week that Michelangelo died], [Mark Twain and Andrew Carnegie were born in the same year], and [Shakespeare and Cervantes were born in the same year].
cards.real: Cervantes was born in 1547, 17 years before Shakespeare. The pair did die in the same year, 1616.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Hawking born January 8, 1942; Ali born January 17, 1942) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_Hawking
NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Carnegie born November 25, 1835; Twain born November 30, 1835) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrew_Carnegie

cards.say: [The Eastern Roman Empire still existed when the Aztecs founded Tenochtitlan], [Easter Island's moai statues were carved before Rome was founded], [Ireland's Newgrange tomb is older than the Great Pyramid of Giza], and [explorers first spotted Antarctica after the United States was founded].
cards.real: Rome's traditional founding date is 753 BC. People didn't settle Easter Island until around 800 to 1200 AD, and the moai were carved after that.

cards.say: [A movie was streamed over the internet before Netflix was even founded], [Facebook was up and running before LinkedIn launched], [Pizza Hut was taking pizza orders online back in 1994], and [the PlayStation 2 was still being made five years after the PS3 came out].
cards.real: LinkedIn launched in May 2003. Facebook didn't launch until February 2004.

cards.say: [The real girl behind Alice in Wonderland visited New York in 1932], [the last crown prince of Austria-Hungary lived until 2011], [the first monthly Social Security check went to a woman who collected for 35 years], and [Napoleon was still alive when Queen Victoria took the throne].
cards.real: Napoleon died in 1821, 16 years before Victoria became queen in 1837.

cards.say: [The first chocolate chip cookies were baked back in the 1890s], [Dr Pepper was being served in Texas before Coca-Cola existed], [the oldest recording of a human voice is older than the phonograph], and [the classic Nokia ringtone comes from a guitar piece written in 1902].
cards.real: Ruth Wakefield baked the first chocolate chip cookies at the Toll House Inn in Massachusetts in 1938.

cards.say: [The last independent Maya kingdom fell after Newton published his laws of motion], [work on Neuschwanstein Castle began after the American Civil War ended], [India's Taj Mahal is older than Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow], and [Hawaii's royal palace had electric lights before the White House did].
cards.real: Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow was built from 1555 to 1561. Work on the Taj Mahal didn't begin until 1632, about 70 years later.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Saint Basil's built 1555 to 1561; Taj Mahal begun 1632, finished 1653) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saint_Basil%27s_Cathedral

cards.say: [Woodstock happened less than a month after the Moon landing], [the Rubik's Cube was invented after the first Sony Walkman went on sale], [Apple was founded before the first Star Wars movie came out], and [NBA games had no three-point line until 1979].
cards.real: Ernő Rubik invented his cube in 1974, five years before Sony's first Walkman went on sale in 1979.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Moon landing July 20, 1969; Woodstock August 15-18, 1969) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woodstock
NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Rubik made his cube in 1974; the Walkman went on sale in July 1979) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rubik%27s_Cube
NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: the NBA adopted the three-point line for the 1979-80 season) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-point_field_goal

cards.say: [Queen Elizabeth II's first prime minister was born in 1874], [King Tut's tomb was found the same year the BBC began broadcasting], [Greece didn't switch to the modern calendar until 1923], and [Russia's October Revolution actually took place in September].
cards.real: Russia still used the old Julian calendar, so the revolution's October 25 was November 7 everywhere else. It was late, not early.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Churchill, born 1874, was prime minister at Elizabeth II's 1952 accession) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winston_Churchill

cards.say: [Germany paid off the last of its World War I debts in 2010], [the Republic of Venice lasted more than a thousand years], [Concorde was still flying passengers when the first iPhone came out], and [the original VW Beetle was still being built in Mexico in 2003].
cards.real: Concorde's last passenger flight was in October 2003, almost four years before the first iPhone went on sale in June 2007.

cards.say: [The word OK started out as army slang during World War I], [the first known written OMG was in a 1917 letter to Winston Churchill], [the oldest known use of the word nerd is in a 1950 Dr. Seuss book], and [Santa Fe, New Mexico was founded before the Pilgrims reached Plymouth].
cards.real: OK first appeared in an 1839 Boston newspaper as a jokey short form of oll korrect, a misspelling of all correct.
